subject: math
description: Illustrate mutually exclusive and non-mutually exclusive events, then choose the correct addition rule for probability.
learningObjectives: Illustrate mutually exclusive and non-mutually exclusive events using lists and Venn diagrams.
Identify whether two events can happen at the same time in one trial.
Use P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) for mutually exclusive events.
Use P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B) when events overlap.
Explain why checking for overlap prevents double-counting.
prerequisites: Identify outcomes in a sample space
Read two-way counts or category descriptions
